prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide landing-page hero for a private offline financial statement review utility. Scene: a handcrafted surreal editorial diorama on a dark moss desk. Subject: one cream bank statement with abstract unmarked rows folded into a winding garden path, columns becoming stepping stones, three small recurring moons above it, one softly worn brass review pin, no people. Style: tactile cut paper and matte gouache, subtle paper fibres, refined magazine editorial still life. Composition: 3:2 landscape, slightly elevated 50mm view, main subject on the right with calm deep-green negative space toward the upper left, clean silhouette. Lighting: warm desk-lamp pool against deep forest evening shadow. Palette: parchment, forest moss, coral pencil, antique ochre, inky charcoal. No readable text, no numbers, no logos, no bank branding, no screens, no currency symbols, no smooth digital gradients, no watermark, no photoreal people, no clutter.
review: Accepted: no readable text, logos, identifiable brands, people, broken seams, or misleading interface elements. Palette and subject match the design thesis.
